dedupe_keys.name: namibia statistics agency population and housing census 2011 public use microdata sample 20 percent housing record with outer walls roof floor energy for cooking lighting and heating water source toilet facility and waste disposal coded by region constituency and urban or rural area

description: The Namibia Statistics Agency runs a national data archive that lists the 2011 Population and Housing Census as a public use microdata sample with open data access. The study page describes it as an edited, anonymous 20 percent sample, version 1.0 dated June 2013. The housing file holds 94,774 household records with 28 variables, coded by region, constituency and urban or rural area. For each household it gives housing type, tenure, dwelling units, sleeping rooms, outer walls, roof, floor, the energy source for cooking, lighting and heating, water source, toilet facility and waste disposal, plus own agricultural activity and a household weight. Person and mortality files sit alongside it. Coverage is national. Format and access: the Get Microdata page asks the user to accept terms that allow commercial and non-commercial reuse with attribution, after which the housing and person records download as SPSS files; the data dictionary and a DDI codebook are open without any step. Caveats: this is 2011 data; the 2023 census dissemination site shows population figures by region and constituency, and its constituency charts showed no data when read, and no 2023 housing tables were found; the 2023 main report link on the census site returned 404. Simulation uses: synthetic household populations with building material and energy and water source by constituency for electrification, water supply and flood exposure studies. Related records: the WorldPop GRID3 census-based population grids and IPUMS International.

name: Namibia Statistics Agency Population and Housing Census 2011 public use microdata sample (20 percent), housing record with outer walls, roof, floor, energy for cooking, lighting and heating, water source, toilet facility and waste disposal, coded by region, constituency and urban or rural area
schema_summary: HOUSING_REC, 94,774 cases and 28 variables: REGION, CONSTITUENCY, URBAN_RURAL, HH_TYPE, household serial number, H1 housing type, H2 tenure, H3 dwelling units, H4 sleeping rooms, H5 outer walls, H6 roof, H7 floor, H8A to H8C energy source for cooking, lighting and heating, H9 water source, H10 toilet facility, H11 waste disposal, H13 language, H14 income source, H15 to H17 own agriculture (livestock, crop, poultry), HWGT household weight. Separate PERSON_REC and MORTALITY_REC files.
